description: This file defines core shape rendering classes and methods for OrchardCore's display management, including shape rendering, list handling, and message display.

classes.name: CoreShapes
classes.description: Provides shape rendering methods such as List and Message for OrchardCore display management.

classes.name: CoreShapesTableProvider
classes.description: Configures shape properties for list shapes within OrchardCore.

methods.name: PlaceChildContent
methods.description: Placeholder method for placing child content within a shape; not implemented.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Renders a list of items as an HTML unordered list with customizable item tags, classes, and attributes.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Renders a message shape as a styled div with role alert.

methods.name: DiscoverAsync
methods.description: Initializes shape properties for list shapes during discovery.
